question.text: A charge of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> is moving with a velocity of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>6</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> along the positive <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi></math>-axis under a magnetic field <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> of strength <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>)</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>. The force acting on the charge is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is ______.

solution.text:
Given:

q=4 μC,v→=4×106 j^ m s-1 and B→=2 k^ T

Force acting on charged particle, F→=q(v→×B→)

=4×10-64×106 j^×2 k^

=4×10-6×8×106i^

⇒F→=32 i^ N

⇒x=32
